description: In Si Ling's family, there is a saying that if you kiss your soulmate, you will be able to enter each other's dream. One day, Si Ling unexpectedly met the An family's young master, An Yunxiu, and accidentally gave him her first kiss. Who would have thought that Si Ling was the first girl who was able to touch An Yunxiu? It was a fate that was already set, and nobody can break it.
